narrative.executive_summary: Your platform currently faces a systemic replenishment control failure as the primary threat, with 8 of 11 missions flagged MEDIUM severity and risk scores clustering at 42-47. Automated reorder logic has breached on 21 high-velocity products yet recommends 0 units for replenishment, creating imminent lost-sales exposure for top sellers including Biscuits (30 units), Mouse (28 units), and an anomalous Unknown SKU (422 units). Concurrent margin pressure is evident across 36 size-variant items generating ₹261,419 profit on ₹820,481 sales, with size-based cost inversion eroding profitability. Without immediate manual override, phantom restock loops and stale reorder points will drive stockouts and revenue leakage within days.
